score_bert_score: score BERTScore for a list of hypotheses against reference translations
create_bert_score_scorer: create a BERTScoreScorer instance registered under the 'bert_score' scorer name
compute_corpus_bert_score: compute corpus-level BERTScore by averaging sentence-level scores
compute_group_bert_score: compute grouped BERTScore scores by sentence tags
classify_language_bert_score: classify the language of references automatically using langid for BERTScore
